content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Melbourne

steps_items.heading: 1. Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verified project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and degree requirements for the PMP®—your background in aerospace, defense, healthcare, IT, or manufacturing likely qualifies. Granite PM Academy's advisors can confirm your eligibility before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: 2. Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course designed for working professionals. Attend sessions online from your Melbourne location on a flexible schedule. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world project scenarios and exam-aligned content across five days or part-time formats to fit your pace.

steps_items.heading: 3. Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP® application directly to PMI with your contact hours certificate and project experience documentation. Pay the PMI examination fee and await eligibility verification. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application requirements and deadlines throughout this phase.

steps_items.heading: 4. Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions led by certified instructors. Schedule your computer-based exam at an approved Pearson VUE testing center. Our targeted review sessions address high-risk domains and exam strategy before your test date.

steps_items.heading: 5. Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle through continued education, project work, and professional service. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing advanced courses and PDU-eligible workshops to keep your skills current and support recertification without interruption.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
